rows: hazel-jit on its own, from dev: the compiler, the values across, mixed mode and holes in it, the agreement tests. New since ^report(63), which had the jit inside #2857.
The package: everything below that it uses, merged with dev and ported to Jane Street Core; hazel-jit now arrives by merging #2859.
The library, first version: Hazel.analyze and Hazel.run from any page.
Programs of named modules (analyzeProgram, runProgram), and Hazel in another page’s frame.
Embed mode: editable cells, one module at a time, go to definition across cells.
IBM Plex Sans as the interface font, in place of a Helvetica Neue that Hazel had no license to ship.
Material Icons shipped with Hazel, so nothing loads from Google.
hazel-jit on the livelits line: livelit views compiled.
SInt with 64 bits everywhere, overflow an error. Not in #2859 or #2857 yet.
Statics: a let analyzed once unless it refers to itself. Not in the package; tried under it today (^ticket(894)).
Statics: a module binding as a non-recursive let. The same experiment.
